licenses.bsd_style_subpackages: pkg/sync/* contains BSD-style files derived from Go stdlib and gVisor; original Copyright notices for The Go Authors and The gVisor Authors are preserved unmodified.
licenses.apache_section_4b_compliance: All 4 modified files retain original Copyright headers and carry explicit // Modified by Kat Authors notices; core/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md documents the local snapshot and 4 modified files.

business_modified_pool_files.modification_summary: Windows-only bounded LIFO chunkPools (11 tiers: 64B..64KiB, maxSlots=[512,2048,256,256,128,512,64,32,32,32,48]), lazy slot init, nil-on-Get root break, lock-free clear(c.data) on reuse, c.data=nil on overflow; non-Windows keeps sync.Pool.
Windows-only bounded LIFO viewPool (maxSlots=4096), lazy slot init, nil-on-Get root break, *v = View{} after v.chunk.DecRef() before pooling; non-Windows keeps sync.Pool.
Windows-only bounded LIFO pkPool (maxSlots=2048), lazy slot init, nil-on-Get root break, pk.reset() after refCount==0 + onRelease() + buf.Release() before pooling; non-Windows keeps sync.Pool.

Windows-only bounded LIFO segmentPool (maxSlots=2048), lazy slot init, nil-on-Get root break, *s = segment{} after refCount==0 + recvQ accounting + pkt.DecRef() before pooling; non-Windows keeps sync.Pool.

notice_and_module_files.change: Update line 56 to document ./third_party/gvisor 42-package snapshot from 69c2d17aea96 and the 4 Windows-only bounded pool files
Minimal go.mod requiring only the 4 external dependencies already locked in core/go.mod (btree, x/exp, x/sys, x/time)
